description: List the next (or, with direction "previous", the most recent past) run times of a cron expression in an IANA time zone, DST-aware. Each run has the local time with its UTC offset, the UTC time, unix seconds and weekday. Default 5 runs, max 20; searches up to 50 years. Read-only. Same engine as GET /api/next and GET /api/previous.

expression.description: Cron expression, e.g. "0 9 * * 1-5", "*/15 * * * *", "0 30 8 * * *" (6 fields = leading seconds) or "@daily".

from.description: Start point (exclusive); default now. ISO 8601 with Z or an offset (2026-11-01T09:00:00Z), a local time read in the time zone (2026-11-01T09:00), or unix seconds.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the schedule runs in, e.g. "America/Denver", "Europe/London". Default UTC.

name: next_cron_runs

time.description: Local ISO 8601 time with UTC offset

title: List next (or previous) cron run times
